changelog: A failed `apm install plugin@marketplace` no longer leaves a marketplace version pin under APM_HOME (#4217)

ledger_row.summary: A marketplace install that failed and reported no committed transaction changes still wrote the plugin ref pin to APM_HOME cache/marketplace/version-pins.json, because the resolver recorded pins before the install committed.
